character_description: Persephone, goddess with dual nature—above ground shows spring maiden beauty with golden hair and warm eyes, in Underworld becomes dark queen with silver-black hair and eyes reflecting all mysteries. Her transformation is her power, not her imprisonment.
setting: Surface world of eternal spring and Underworld kingdom of profound truth
theme: Claiming power through choice and understanding duality

video_prompts: Persephone gathers flowers in eternal spring, unaware her destiny transcends her mother's protective boundaries.
first_frame_prompt: Young Persephone moves through infinite spring flowers, golden hair glowing with sunlight, eyes warm and curious. Around her, world perpetually blooms in Demeter's protection. Yet her gaze reaches beyond visible horizon—sensing deeper meaning hidden beneath eternal spring. The flowers seem to whisper secrets she's not yet ready to hear.
speech: There must be more than eternal spring. Somewhere, there is autumn and winter.

video_prompts: Persephone chooses to descend to Underworld, reclaiming agency her mother attempted to deny her.
first_frame_prompt: Persephone walks willingly downward, her transformation visible and profound. Golden hair becomes silver-black with mystery. Warm eyes transform into depths reflecting all Underworld truths. She descends not as victim but as explorer choosing to comprehend complete reality. Her power emerges through this choice.
speech: I choose to understand all seasons, not just eternal spring.

video_prompts: Persephone teaches women throughout Greece about claiming agency and honoring their full complexity.
first_frame_prompt: Persephone becomes teacher and guide for women learning to reclaim their own power. Her dual hair and eyes become symbol of integrated self. She moves between communities, showing women how to honor all seasons of their lives, not remain frozen in perpetual maiden status.
speech: You do not need permission to become yourself.

speech: Love that denies freedom is merely control dressed in affection.
